8.en: Acolytes of the Inquisition must be skilled and talented to pursue and purge the enemies of the Imperium. Some demonstrate these capabilities before joining the Inquisition, recruited due to their outstanding ability. Others continue to hone such talents in service to the Inquisition, adapting to new demands and the dangers of their duty.

If a character seeks to Specialise in a Skill, or the GM would like to introduce a unique Specialisation useful for their specific campaign — they should feel free to do so. But it is essential to remember that Specialisations are supposed to be particular expertise within a given Skill; they should not be broad and should be tied to a given Skill easily.
